excluded.policy: DNS and IP-database services do not participate in adblock API conversion, operation inventories or remaining-work priorities; no emulation, native binding or source deletion

scriptHub.approach: Native runtime API facade; author business expressions and Env objects execute unchanged

headers.domain: Case-insensitive lowercase Header dictionary Proxy, get/set/delete/has/define/descriptor, Symbol-safe; native dictionaries are copied
headers.outside: This is an explicit ScriptHub-compatible normalization policy; original key casing and duplicate-case keys are not preserved. Full-header arrays are not supported

http.domain: Seven dynamic methods, concurrent requests, Promise rejection and callbacks, source defaults, units, policy names, exact byte views and Loon body-base64 decoding; preserve native QX decoded text and honor explicit foreign response charset with actual TextDecoder; QX-undocumented parameters omitted without deleting argument construction
http.outside: No fabricated timeout/cancellation on QX. Unsupported response charset rejects with UNSUPPORTED_RESPONSE_CHARSET; native detailed errors, cookie state, ALPN, h2_trailers and source-version differences can remain observable

storage.domain: Dynamic String keys/values, explicit deletion and source-name default keys; native return/error behavior retained
storage.outside: Missing null/undefined and empty-value behavior may remain target-native. Unknown source default name throws at invocation; no invented shared namespace or empty-string deletion probe

completion.domain: Dynamic completion dictionaries and wrappers, source status/byte field conversion, flat/wrapped synthetic responses; failed result validation permits author catch/fallback before the single host submission
completion.outside: QX synthetic response requires an echo declaration; target QX body/header restrictions and unavailable fields are checked at invocation. No catch-and-pass-through suppression

environment.domain: Env receivers and functions are ordinary JavaScript; source API presence is provided by the facade. Loon presence marker identifies compatibility, not a target version
environment.outside: Actual source device/version/source-path values cannot be reconstructed; dynamically constructed Function code and unsupported native engines are not emulated

codecs.domain: Scoped UTF-8/Base64 plus native-first TextDecoder with lazy Exodus bytes 1.16.0 legacy labels, streaming/fatal/BOM support and exact byte views
codecs.outside: Unknown encoding labels reject. Native decoding is preferred and otherwise a pinned Exodus decoder handles standard legacy labels. WASM, require and file/control APIs need actual target support; no empty implementations

compression.domain: Synchronous Uint8Array API; exact cross-realm views; native Loon first, otherwise lazy isolated provider; gzip framing and complete stream plus CRC/trailer validation; explicit failure codes
compression.outside: Valid gzip encoding bytes/header metadata and error messages may differ from native Loon. No compression algorithm is reimplemented locally

crypto.domain: Native Loon AES first; otherwise synchronous ECB/CBC/CTR/GCM, 16/24/32-byte keys, PKCS7/none, 12-byte GCM nonce, AAD and separate authenticated tag
crypto.outside: Invalid parameters and authentication failures throw; source error strings/codes are not promised byte-for-byte identical

url.domain: Native URL/URLSearchParams pair first, otherwise a linked WHATWG implementation with IDNA, parsing, setters, iteration, parse/canParse and query parameter methods
url.outside: The pinned specification revision and actual engine versions may differ from future standards

nativeBoundaries.storage: Loon remove maps to QX removeAllValues; Surge clear-all is intentionally ignored without deleting keys or reporting success
nativeBoundaries.http: QX omits undocumented options. User policy omits Surge ALPN and h2_trailers/node/policy completion fields without errors
nativeBoundaries.headers: Only Loon/QX dictionary source contracts are adapted; Surge full-header arrays are not a new source conversion direction
nativeBoundaries.notification: Surge posts content immediately, ignoring delay and click actions; remote images use media-url, PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP inline images use media-base64 and media-base64-mime; unknown media is omitted. QX extra options are omitted
nativeBoundaries.identity: Real source device/version/sourcePath cannot be reconstructed; no fabricated identity
nativeBoundaries.policy: Native/absent boundaries are descriptive, never author-source whitelist gates or success suppression

capabilities.verification: API contract vectors and mock transports, syntax and backup integrity. Generated compatibility means API adapter composition succeeded, not every author business path or device runtime was verified
